description: Radio frequencies for one airfield from the OurAirports dataset: type (ATIS/TWR/GND/CLD/DIR/APP/DEP/CTAF/UNICOM/...), a human description, and the frequency in MHz. Pass any code ourairports_lookup accepts. An airfield with no frequencies on file returns an empty list with found:true, not an error. An unrecognized airfield code is refused with a clear error, never an empty success.
name: airport_frequencies
title: Airport Frequencies
